engine: Turbospectrum_NLTE (BSYN v20.1) — Gerber TS-native in-synthesis NLTE (Engine-B)
paper: Gerber, Bergemann et al. 2023, A&A 669, A43 (arXiv 2206.00967)
provenance_caveat: NO DOI, mutable Seafile -> md5-pinned (RYA-540). The payload was ALREADY STAGED on Sirius before this ticket: RYA-785 was filed saying atom.fe607a was 'AVAILABLE-NEVER-PULLED', but all three files were on disk. What was missing was this provenance record — the element status tracker reads the REGISTRATION, not the disk, so an unregistered-but-present deck reads as never fetched. Nothing was re-downloaded; the staged bytes were md5'd in place.
sirius_only: Sirius /srv/codex/grids/nlte/gerber_ts/ only (RYA-526/567). The 3.9 GB .bin is symlinked out to /mnt/codex-data/gerber_overflow/ (the RYA-710 spill-over plan).

model_atom.name: atom.fe607a
model_atom.note: 607 levels (548 Fe I, 58 Fe II, 1 Fe III), 12635 transitions; cut at log gf > -5 and lambda < 20000 A. Fe I levels from Kurucz, Fe II from Bertrand Plez.

grid_1d_bin_zip.name: NLTEgrid4TS_Fe_MARCS_May-07-2021.bin.zip
grid_1d_bin_zip.note: unpacked .bin is 3.9 GB. Key name is grid_1d_bin_zip, NOT 1d_bin — the loader reads this key (RYA-772).

deck_abundance.why: NOT the 7.50 printed in the atom.fe607a header. bsyn STOPs with 'NLTE departure coeff calculated for abundance = 7.46 while it is 7.50 here' — the departure coefficients were computed at 7.46, so the synthesis must run at 7.46 or they do not apply. A property of the deck, not a fitted value.

gate.lines: Fe I 5806.725 / 6027.070 / 5905.671 — selected by scripts/rya785_pick_gate_lines.py against four requirements at once: BOTH GES NLTE levels identified (the Co/Ni silent-departure=1 trap), inside the committed MPIA per-line grid (so the anchor is per-line), measured in-aggregate by us, and well-measured at 69-72 mA rather than weak (the Ti weak-line trap).
gate.anchor: +0.0124 (median of these same three lines' OWN Fe_Bergemann_MPIA per-line deltas: +0.0115 / +0.0125 / +0.0124). Read from the grid, not assumed or averaged at element level.
gate.verdict: CHECK (not PASS): |median - anchor| = 0.051 > tol 0.05, marginally. FINDING — not a deck failure: departures engaged, all three lines return a consistent positive delta, and the Gerber deck runs ~5x the Bergemann-MPIA value on the same lines. This is the THIRD instance of the Gerber-vs-MPIA model-atom systematic already recorded for Ti (~2x) and Mn (~1/2), so it is a cross-engine model-atom difference for RYA-525 to carry as a DIAGNOSTIC, never folded into the error bar. Not tuned toward MPIA or Asplund (RYA-785 forbids it).
gate.harness_defect_found: The first run of this gate reported a plausible +0.300 from a TWO-DAY-OLD Fe_nlte.spec: bsyn had failed, and the gate's `os.path.exists()` success check could not tell 'this run wrote it' from 'a previous run left it' in the shared, never-cleaned {W}/work directory. Fixed in the same commit by a mtime-based stale guard on the interpolator, babsma and bsyn outputs. Same family as RYA-759's 0-byte spectrum and RYA-716's smoke-test overwrite.
